mapper.sql: id, template_scope, owner_user_id, owner_scope_key, template_name, active_name_key, task_title, difficulty_level, duration_minutes, category_code, remark, sort_order, status, version_no, created_by_user_id, updated_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM learn_task_template WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND (template_scope = 'SYSTEM' OR (template_scope = 'PERSONAL' AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId})) ORDER BY CASE WHEN template_scope = 'SYSTEM' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM learn_task_template WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM learn_task_template WHERE template_scope = 'PERSONAL' AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learn_task_template WHERE template_scope = 'PERSONAL' AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 10 FROM learn_task_template WHERE template_scope = 'PERSONAL' AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND status = 'ENABLED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learn_task_template ( id, template_scope, owner_user_id, owner_scope_key, template_name, active_name_key, task_title, difficulty_level, duration_minutes, category_code, remark, sort_order, status, version_no, created_by_user_id, updated_by_user_id ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{templateScope}, #{ownerUserId}, #{ownerScopeKey}, #{templateName}, #{activeNameKey}, #{taskTitle}, #{difficultyLevel}, #{durationMinutes}, #{categoryCode}, #{remark}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{versionNo}, #{createdByUserId}, #{updatedByUserId} )
INSERT INTO learn_task_template_tag (id, template_id, tag_code) VALUES (#{id}, #{templateId}, #{tagCode})
mapper.update: UPDATE learn_task_template SET template_name = #{template.templateName}, active_name_key = #{template.activeNameKey}, task_title = #{template.taskTitle}, difficulty_level = #{template.difficultyLevel}, duration_minutes = #{template.durationMinutes}, category_code = #{template.categoryCode}, remark = #{template.remark}, updated_by_user_id = #{template.updatedByUserId}, version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{template.id} AND owner_user_id = #{template.ownerUserId} AND template_scope = 'PERSONAL' AND status = 'ENABLED' AND version_no = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE learn_task_template SET status = 'DELETED', active_name_key = NULL, updated_by_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND template_scope = 'PERSONAL' AND status = 'ENABLED' AND version_no = #{expectedVersion}
